title: Words That Bring Life
opening: Words can strengthen or wound. God calls believers to speak truth with grace and to use their speech to build others up.
points: Pause before speaking when emotions are strong.
Tell the truth without cruelty, gossip, or humiliation.
Offer encouragement that is sincere and specific.
reflection: Who could be encouraged by your words today?
prayer: Lord, guard my mouth and shape my words. Help me speak truth with love and use my voice to build others up. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
